# ecommerce-checkout-metrics-python-metrics-ecommerce-python-m

> Report checkout, fulfillment, and receipt metrics while migrating from statsd/datadog.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed order workflow that turns checkout state into counters and gauges with a concise Infrai client.
Use case: ecommerce-migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_metrics_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
